types.name: Speed, time and distance basics
types.description: A direct use of distance = speed × time, unit conversion between km/h and m/s, or a journey split into parts at different speeds where distance or time is asked.

types.name: Average speed
types.description: The question asks for the average speed of a whole journey made at different speeds, or gives the average speed and asks for one of the speeds.

types.name: Change in speed changes time
types.description: The speed is increased or decreased by a fixed amount and the time changes by a given amount, or two vehicles cover distances with related speeds and times; find the speed or distance.

types.name: Late and early arrival
types.description: Travelling at a fraction of the usual speed (or at two different speeds) makes the person late or early by some minutes; find the usual time or the distance.

types.name: Meeting and chasing
types.description: Two people or vehicles move towards each other or one chases the other, possibly starting at different times; find when or where they meet.

types.name: Trains crossing
types.description: A train crosses a pole, a man, a platform, a bridge, a tunnel or another train, and its length, speed or time is asked.

types.name: Boats and streams
types.description: A boat or swimmer goes upstream and downstream in a river, and the speed in still water, the stream speed, a distance or a time is asked.

types.name: Circular track
types.description: Two or more people run or ride around a circular track, and the time of their first meeting or their meeting at the starting point is asked.

types.name: Races
types.description: A race in which one runner beats another by some metres or seconds, or gives a head start, and a speed, time or margin is asked.

types.name: Stoppage time
types.description: A train or bus has one average speed without stoppages and a lower one with stoppages; find how many minutes it stops per hour.
